notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger or Zuko.
You have seven or more experience counters.
description:
Declare Hellkite Charger and Zuko as attackers, triggering each of their abilities.
Resolve the Zuko trigger, adding an amount of {R} equal to the number of experience counters you have.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
